action_id.description: Optional stored AI Action id. Supply when allow/deny lists are configured or when you want to pin execution to a known action.

instruction.description: Natural-language instruction that Zapier AI Actions should resolve and execute.

preview_only.description: When true, request a review/preview response instead of committing the action.

params_hints.description: Optional hints for app-specific parameters that help Zapier resolve the action safely.
